title: UNITED CONSIDERED HIM. HURZELER JUST SHUT THE DOOR!
description:
Manchester United considered Fabian Hurzeler. Then they hired Pochettino instead.

Now Hurzeler has answered the rumours, and it is a polite no thanks. He called the outside interest speculation and said he is fully committed to Brighton.

Brighton are second in the Premier League, and chairman Tony Bloom says he will fight very hard to keep him. Hurzeler took over in 2024 as one of the youngest managers in Premier League history. As references go, second place is a decent one. United got Pochettino, Brighton kept their man, and somebody in Manchester needs a longer shortlist.

Honest question: if you were Hurzeler, would you stay at Brighton or take the United call? Tell us in the comments.
